candidates.title: System discovery and relay bootstrap contract
candidates.slice_summary: Verify `Nostr discovery events (kind 31974 + NIP-51 kind 30002)` as the authoritative bootstrap contract for browser relays, encrypted-request relays, service pubkey discovery, feature gating, control-plane kind advertisement, cached Nostr discovery loading, EOSE-bounded read-model bootstrap, and transition into live subscriptions.
candidates.why_this_is_a_gap: Existing PSTF slices depend on `Nostr discovery events (kind 31974 + NIP-51 kind 30002)` and relay bootstrap behavior, but none verify that contract as its own feature. `pstf/spec_gap_report.md` calls both `Nostr discovery events (kind 31974 + NIP-51 kind 30002)` and relay-read-model-first frontend behavior under-specified.
proposed_acceptance_focus: `Nostr discovery events (kind 31974 + NIP-51 kind 30002)` advertises public relays, encrypted-request relays, service pubkey, feature flags, and control-plane kind maps coherently.
The browser caches and deduplicates Nostr discovery loads instead of refetching per store.
Public control-plane bootstrap waits for EOSE, applies stored read models, and then stays live through subscriptions.
Bootstrap fails closed when relay-read-model capability or browser relays are not advertised.

candidates.title: Encrypted service secrets CRUD and reveal safety
candidates.slice_summary: Verify encrypted secrets list/create/update/delete/reveal operations, including the boundary that secret values are never rendered in list views, reveal is explicit, and the reveal-after-update workflow stays scoped to encrypted request/result transport.
candidates.why_this_is_a_gap: The encrypted notifications feature intentionally scopes itself to notifications and excludes other encrypted domains. Secrets are implemented as a separate encrypted route domain with both transport-level and page-level behavior, but there is no dedicated PSTF feature for it.
proposed_acceptance_focus: Secrets CRUD uses encrypted request/result operations rather than public relays or plain REST as the normative contract.
List views and post-create refreshes never expose plaintext secret values.
Reveal requires an explicit action and returns plaintext only to the requester context.
Update + reveal + clipboard copy behaves deterministically and leaves reveal disabled when no value is cached.

candidates.title: Hive-CI workflow run/result ingestion into the build-artifact pipeline
candidates.slice_summary: Verify relay-driven ingestion of Hive-CI workflow run (`5401`) and workflow result (`5402`) events, including signature validation, trusted-publisher checks, orphan-result handling, and downstream mapping into repository CI state or artifact/build workflows.
candidates.why_this_is_a_gap: The product map calls out OCI registry + CI bridge as a major capability, but the spec-gap report says the current integration proof is thin and the named end-to-end integration file is mostly scaffold.
proposed_acceptance_focus: The subscriber consumes both workflow run and result events via subscriptions, not polling.
Invalid signatures or publisher mismatches are rejected before persistence or downstream processing.
Result-before-run ordering is handled deterministically through pending/orphan states.
Repository CI lookup reflects linked policies and latest run/result state once ingestion succeeds.
